cadence_diagnostic.finding: Request spacing changes USB and HTP service time even without CUDA. Alternating treatment and controls is not a valid steady-path latency estimate.

mechanical_changes: Fused gate and up into one resident HTP matmul.
Used scaled int8 input and f16 activation output on the wire.
Replaced scalar lround input quantization with equivalent vectorizable rounding.
Pinned the root phone worker to CPUs 6-7 under SCHED_FIFO priority 20.
Built the late CUDA graph with the completed prefix as an external leaf.
Fused the suffix down projection and prefix bias into one two-node CUDA graph.

interpretation.phone_wait: The steady phone path is below the CUDA prefix at p90 for both shapes. Rare outliers remain, so an all-sample no-wait claim is rejected.
interpretation.latency: The phone is no longer the median or p90 critical path. The late CUDA continuation is larger than the CUDA work removed by a 256-column cut, so M=1 remains slower.
interpretation.energy: No power acquisition was run for this successor. The prior full-output server-energy result must not be reused.
interpretation.next_bounded_test: Batch independent requests so one late continuation and transport cadence are amortized. Test B=2,4,8 and stop unless total CUDA-plus-phone latency or useful throughput beats the matched CUDA control.

limitations: This is a synthetic FFN probe, not full-model llama decode.
The input is already host-resident; a real CUDA-to-host FFN-input handoff is not included.
The A6000 is clock-limited but is not a faithful RTX 4060 Ti substitute for every kernel.
Phone and fleet energy are unmeasured in this successor.
